about: The Plan of the Gate: the shape of Eiko's ten rooms and twenty-two paths on the Tree that every egbe house shares. Read by scripts/build-plan.js together with rooms/ and paths/, which stay Eiko's. Stations are hidden architecture: ghosted, never signage. Agreed with Eiko, 10 October 2026.
dark_by_choice_note: Paths Eiko keeps dark on purpose, even once written. Darkness is not absence; it is a choice.
